[LFST.2.2] An interoperability reference protobuf schema
ships alongside this doc. Integrators wanting
interoperability with off-the-shelf DS tooling
(replayers, debuggers, conformance runners) capture
to that schema. Integrators with bespoke pipelines
(JSON-lines for a log-aggregator, CBOR for embedded,
internal control-plane messages, in-process queues)
encode however suits them. Determinism is preserved
across encodings as long as the encoding is a
faithful round-trip of the typed event content.
